transactions.desc: Miller was sent outright to Triple-A Iowa on Monday.
Burgos was recalled from Triple-A Reno prior to Monday's game against the Cubs.
Wilkinson was optioned to Triple-A Sacramento on Monday, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Molina was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Walker was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento prior to Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Whitcomb was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
McCray was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento ahead of Monday's game against the Reds, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
Furman was recalled from Triple-A Sacramento on Monday, Shayna Rubin of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
The Astros signed Velazquez to a major-league contract Monday, Matt Kawahara of the Houston Chronicle reports.
Delgado was optioned to Triple-A Sugar Land on Monday, Chandler Rome of The Athletic reports.
The Padres optioned Song to Triple-A El Paso on Monday.
The Padres selected Harris' contract from Triple-A El Paso on Monday.
The Diamondbacks optioned Bratt to Triple-A Reno on Monday, Steve Gilbert of MLB.com reports.
Miami optioned De Los Santos to Triple-A Jacksonville on Monday.
The Marlins reinstated Stowers (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list Monday. He'll start at first base and bat third in the series opener versus the Red Sox.
The Rockies selected Adams' contract from Triple-A Albuquerque on Monday.
The Tigers designated Vanasco for assignment Monday, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
The Tigers optioned Madden to Triple-A Toledo on Monday, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
The Tigers signed Kinley to a one-year contract, Cody Stavenhagen of The Athletic reports.
Suarez elected to become a free agent Monday, Roch Kubako of MASNSports.com reports.
The Yankees optioned Beck to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre on Monday.
The Brewers optioned Naylor to Triple-A Nashville on Monday.
Atlanta recalled Hicklen from Triple-A Gwinnett on Tuesday.
Atlanta optioned Jarvis to Triple-A Gwinnett on Monday.
The Mariners outrighted Diaz to Triple-A Tacoma on Monday.
Bodine was promoted to Triple-A Durham on Sunday, Chase Ford of MiLB Central reports.
De Los Santos is being optioned back to Triple-A Jacksonville following Sunday's 6-2 win over the Nationals, Isaac Azout of FishOnFirst.com reports.
The Brewers recalled Naylor from Triple-A Nashville to serve as the 27th player for Sunday's Little League Classic against Atlanta, Todd Rosiak of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
The Mariners recalled Wisdom from Triple-A Tacoma on Sunday, Daniel Kramer of MLB.com reports.
The Diamondbacks recalled Carrillo from Triple-A Reno on Sunday.
